HISTORY, SUPERSEDED BY THE DESTRUCTOR FOLD (last boundary_evidence entry): Why the order cannot be reproduced, measured on this class: the cartridge puts D0 (0x02126fbc) BELOW D1 (0x02127014). With the destructor defined in the class body, mwccarm 2004/b56 emits D1 then D0 -- unchanged by moving the declaration below the overrides, by making Render rather than OnHitByMegaChar the first declared out-of-line virtual, and by defer_codegen off (which moves the pair to the end of the object, keeps D1 first, and additionally flips every other member to forward source order). An out-of-line definition DOES emit D0 then D1, verified here at 10/10 MATCH with all ten in ROM-ascending section order -- but it also adds a _ZN13daObjMaruta_cD2Ev the cartridge does not carry, and it is inadmissible for the reason below.

The class-body definition is required independently: include/daObjMaruta_c.h defines the destructor in the class body so that both descendants INLINE the body. Measured both ways with tools/match.py against 2004/b56 -- with the class-body definition _ZN15daObjFlMaruta_cD1Ev, _ZN15daObjFlMaruta_cD0Ev, _ZN15daObjHmMaruta_cD1Ev and _ZN15daObjHmMaruta_cD0Ev all MATCH; with an out-of-line declaration all four shrink to a bl (0x50 to 0x24, and 0x64 to 0x38) and none match. So the header cannot change, and the pair cannot join this TU licensed run (linkcheck refuses a licensed .text that is not ROM-ascending).

Reachability: the only references to either destructor address in config/ are the two vtable words inside _ZTV13daObjMaruta_c (ov080 0x02128338). No instruction in the image calls either address directly, so nothing outside the vtable depends on their order.

DESTRUCTOR FOLD. The licensed run is now 0x02126fbc..0x0212766c (10 functions), with _ZN13daObjMaruta_cD0Ev at 0x02126fbc (size 0x58) and _ZN13daObjMaruta_cD1Ev at 0x02127014 (size 0x44) as its first two members; their per-function shard sources and delinks entries are retired and merged into this TU's. The header is unchanged: the destructor stays in the class body, so daObjFlMaruta_c and daObjHmMaruta_c still inline it. The lever is the one src/game/actors/d_a_obj_fall_block.cpp and src/game/actors/d_a_obj_dorifu.cpp record, which the measurements above did not try in this combination: `#pragma defer_codegen off` before the includes, the file written in ROM-ascending order, and two uncalled forcing functions at the top -- `delete p` (the deleting destructor, D0) then `p->~daObjMaruta_c()` (the complete-object destructor, D1) -- which make mwccarm emit the inline destructor's two variants at parse time in the cartridge's D0-then-D1 order, with no D2. The forcers are compiler_only_output deadstrip rows. The left edge is daPicGate_c_classInit's end at 0x02126fbc.
notes: Promoted from eight per-function sources. This TU defines the key function -- daObjMaruta_c::OnHitByMegaChar, the first out-of-line virtual, the destructor above it being defined in the class body -- so it emits _ZTV13daObjMaruta_c, the five-class RTTI chain and both destructor variants as compiler-only output. All fourteen are licensed below; none is in the licensed .text range.

THE RTTI RECORD AND THE VTABLE ARE IN DIFFERENT MODULES, and each compiler_only_output row is keyed to the module that actually owns the address: _ZTI13daObjMaruta_c and _ZTS13daObjMaruta_c are in ov022 (0x02114350, 0x0211435c), where the daObjFlMaruta_c factory is, while _ZTV13daObjMaruta_c is in ov080 (0x02128338) with the code. include/daObjMaruta_c.h already records the split and how the ov079/ov080 ambiguity on the vtable address is settled.

The four func_ov080_ members keep their placeholder names. They are the class non-virtual shared implementation and both leaves call them by these exact symbols from other overlays, so they keep C linkage; there is no ROM-proven English spelling for any of them. Their bodies still walk a char cursor because the fields they touch, all above 0x320, are the LEAVES fields -- include/daObjMaruta_c.h declares no members of its own and says why.

Not called and not in the ROM: a source-level forcing function. The class destructor is defined inline in include/daObjMaruta_c.h because both descendants inline it, so no file can define it out of line; a delete-expression asks for the deleting variant by name. This file compiles under `#pragma defer_codegen off`, where ordinary functions are emitted at parse time in source order, and this forcer is the parse-time trigger that places D0 first. Emitted just ahead of the licensed D0 section. Homeless: config/ has no symbol row for it.

Not called and not in the ROM: the companion forcing function. An explicit `p->~daObjMaruta_c()` asks for the complete-object variant by name, which the delete-expression forcer cannot also serve. Under `#pragma defer_codegen off` the call places D1 after D0 as the cartridge has them. Emitted between the licensed D0 and D1 sections. Homeless: config/ has no symbol row for it.
